## Overview

Index and activity log for the university mathematics preparation path. Reference material: [Mathematics for High Schools](https://basics2022.github.io/bbooks-math-miscellanea-hs/intro.html).


## Topics & Curriculum

Three main topics: analytic geometry, calculus, and vectors. Other side topics need to be touched for the best understanding of the main topics. Among these: properties of trigonometric and exponential functions, complex numbers.

## Notes and Book Corrections

Errors and missing sections discovered during the tutoring sessions are collected in the log entries and fixed in the source repository. If you find any others, please report them on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Basics2022/bbooks-math-miscellanea-hs/issues/new).
